scope: Additive Healer Puppet L1-18 and spawned Healer audit of Queen self healing, summoned-unit levels and activation timing.
game_version: Official 2023-12 launch; claimed client build 18.600.3 in dated 2026 Equipment and troop tables; version unspecified for independent effect table; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Hero Equipment
facts: Healer Puppet is Common active Archer Queen Equipment unlocked at Blacksmith level 5.
The active ability summons Healers, while the Hero self heals and gains HP.
sources.limitations: No summon count by level, summoned Healer level, healing pulse order, spawn position or activation tick is given.

sources.title: Healer Puppet — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The public per-level Queen HP and cost table matches the pinned payload, including L18 HP 968.
sources.limitations: The public table omits summoned count, summoned level, self heal rate and timing.

sources.title: Healer Puppet
facts: The public L1-18 summoned-Healer count, summoned-Healer level, self-heal-per-second and Queen HP rows match the pinned payload; L18 lists three L8 Healers and 35 self heal per second.
sources.limitations: The page gives no publication/update date or client build and no timing, spawn, target-selection or pulse rules.

sources.title: Healer — Clash of Clans
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The ordinary Healer table publishes L4-8 HP of 1200,1500,1600,1700,1800 and heal rates of 66,72,72,72,76 per second; it describes flying ground-unit healing and no attack.
sources.limitations: The source does not establish whether Puppet Healers inherit every ordinary Healer stat, AI and target priority; it omits spawn position and pulse phase.

sources.title: Pinned Healer Puppet Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: The pinned payload has per-level summonedHealers, healerLevel, selfHealingPerSecond and Queen hitpointIncrease fields.
sources.limitations: The payload gives no activation ordering, Healer AI override, regeneration pulse phase or current game version.

observations.note: All effect fields match the independent version-unknown table; current-build continuity remains unverified.
Ordinary Healer data only; Puppet child stat inheritance is an unverified relationship.

derivations.result: Retain count, Healer-level and self-heal fields as data-only
derivations.method: Cross-check all 18 pinned raw rows against the independent public table; do not assert its unspecified build is current.

derivations.result: Record ordinary Healer levels as candidate spawned-unit data without importing an inheritance rule
derivations.method: Match the Equipment's healerLevel keys to dated ordinary-Healer rows; leave spawn actor and combat AI unmaterialized.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use the player's researched Healer level for Puppet children
rejected_inferences.reason: The pinned Equipment field and independent table name a separate Healer level by Equipment level; player-Laboratory dependence is not sourced.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat Puppet Healers as fully identical to ordinary deployed Healers
rejected_inferences.reason: The checked sources do not establish child AI, follow priority, trap handling or complete stat inheritance.

rejected_inferences.rule: Make the spawned Healers exclusively follow the Queen
rejected_inferences.reason: No checked primary source gives a post-spawn lock or reassignment rule.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply the self-heal rate every 10 ms using fractional accumulation starting at activation
rejected_inferences.reason: The rate is known, but passive start, accumulator rounding, HP cap and pulse order are not documented.

rejected_inferences.rule: Spawn all Healers on the activation tick at fixed offsets
rejected_inferences.reason: Spawn phase, position, collision and entity-ID order are not published.

items: current-build count, summoned level and self-heal continuity
whether self healing is always passive or begins on activation
self-heal tick accumulation, rounding, HP cap and death phase
activation, spawn and simultaneous Equipment tick order
Queen max HP increase and interaction with damage/recovery modifiers
Viewer, snapshot, replay and RL activation
ordinary Healer stat inheritance and current child values
spawn placement, formation, collision and entity-ID order
first heal pulse, cadence, target priority and retargeting
ground-only healing, Hero/Pet/clone eligibility and HP cap
enemy defenses, traps, aura and post-Queen-death behavior

conclusion: Healer Puppet L1-18 and its spawned Healers remain partial and catalogue-only. Active Queen summons, self healing and HP gain are official, while current effect continuity and deterministic child lifecycle, targeting and heal timing are incomplete.
